summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 3D prints e-commerce website. Backend APIs are fully functional (100% success rate), but frontend has authentication and checkout integration issues that need to be addressed.

Admin users are redirected away from admin dashboard despite having admin privileges

passed_tests: All backend API endpoints (18/18 tests passed)
Landing page loads with gradient background and parallax effects
Product listing page displays products with category filters
Product detail page shows product info and quantity controls

Cart page shows items with quantity controls and remove button
Product images and placeholder images display correctly
